column1: FLESH TO DEATH HONEY CO. — MASTER BUSINESS SPREADSHEET
Use this spreadsheet to track inventory, expenses, revenue, taxes, and profitability.
IMPORTANT: Nevada has NO state income tax. You still owe federal income tax and self-employment tax (Social Security + Medicare).
IMPORTANT: Track ALL mileage to/from farmers markets, suppliers, and business meetings. The 2026 IRS standard mileage rate is $0.67/mile.
IMPORTANT: Keep ALL receipts. Photograph them immediately and store digitally.
